foreclosure_notices.notes: Texas is a non-judicial foreclosure state. Notices of Substitute Trustee's Sale must be posted at the George Allen Courts Building and filed with the County Clerk at least 21 days before the first-Tuesday sale date. For sales noticed after 2026-02-24, the County Clerk's foreclosures page directs the public to a dedicated 'Foreclosure' search type on the same PublicSearch portal used for clerk_recordings, filterable by sale date and city. Prior to that date, notices were only published as static PDFs grouped by month and city at dallascounty.org (still usable as a historical/legacy fallback path).
foreclosure_notices.verification_note: Confirmed via the County Clerk's Recording Division 'Find Foreclosure Notices' page, which explicitly names the PublicSearch portal as the current system and describes the sale-date/city filters. Free, no login observed for the foreclosure search type.
foreclosure_notices.portal_type: foreclosure notice search (PublicSearch) + legacy PDF archive

Found taxsales.lgbs.com/api/property_sales/, a public unauthenticated JSON API run by Linebarger Goggan Blair & Sampson covering the same sheriff-sale/tax-foreclosure listings as the blocked RealAuction site, with richer structured data. Resolves the source without Playwright.

sheriff_sales.fingerprint_summary: Superseded by LGBS API discovery -- see notes. Original RealAuction 403 fingerprint retained here for history: RealAuction-hosted auction platform; returned 403 to a plain HTTP fetch.
sheriff_sales.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-23: the originally recon'd RealAuction platform (dallas.texas.sheriffsaleauctions.com) returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch and was marked BLOCKED, pending a Playwright build. Found instead that taxsales.lgbs.com (Linebarger Goggan Blair & Sampson, LLP) publishes a public JSON API covering the same sales -- each record's property_loc field links directly into dallas.texas.sheriffsaleauctions.com for that listing -- and exposes MORE structured data (full address, minimum bid, appraised value, sale status) than the auction site itself would show without a real browser session. This resolves the 403 blocker entirely: no Playwright is needed.
sheriff_sales.verification_note: Live-verified 2026-08-23: GET with no auth/CAPTCHA, standard DRF pagination. 31 SALE + 442 FUTURE SALE = 473 listings confirmed live with real cause numbers, full street addresses, sale dates, appraised values, and minimum bids. Built and ran scrapers/taxsales_lgbs_dallas.py against live data successfully -- same scraper module as tax_foreclosure_resales, split by sale_type.
sheriff_sales.official_entity: Dallas County Sheriff / Tax Office (RealAuction vendor)
sheriff_sales.portal_type: public JSON REST API (LGBS tax sales platform) -- upstream data feed for the RealAuction sheriffsaleauctions.com listings

auto_resolve_attempts.detail: Checked several JP precinct 'Evictions' pages (3-1, 4-1, 5-1, 5-2); all state no online search exists and direct the public to contact the precinct.

jp_eviction.notes: Dallas County has multiple Justice of the Peace precincts (each with its own eviction docket). No official countywide or per-precinct online case-search portal was found; every JP precinct page ('Evictions') directs the public to contact that precinct's office directly by phone/in person. A third-party 'Eviction Filing Dashboard' exists at dallaseac.org (Child Poverty Action Lab, described as done 'in collaboration with Dallas County') but is hosted on a non-government domain and was not verified as an official, government-operated, or scrapable source.
jp_eviction.verification_note: Multiple JP precinct 'Evictions' pages checked via search; consistent message that no online search exists and the public must contact the precinct. Marked NOT_FOUND per Phase 0 hard rule (no invented portals).

open_questions: Confirm the weekly Friday/Monday cadence holds consistently over several weeks of production runs.
Confirm whether older tax-year rows (pre-2000) still carrying a balance represent genuinely collectible distress or long-dormant/uncollectible accounts that should be filtered out downstream.
tax_collector.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-23: the originally recon'd ACT Tax Solutions portal (dallasact.com) is per-account SEARCH ONLY (owner/address/account/fiduciary) with no bulk delinquent-roll listing or export -- it cannot function as a standalone daily-refresh distress-event scraper since there is no way to discover which accounts are newly delinquent without already knowing the account. The Dallas County Tax Office's own site instead publishes a genuine bulk file: the 'Tax Roll (TRW)', an ASCII fixed-width file covering current AND delinquent accounts for every taxing jurisdiction, regenerated every Friday and posted the following Monday. This source now targets that file. The ACT portal remains a useful manual per-property lookup tool but is not scraped.
tax_collector.verification_note: Live-verified 2026-08-23: downloaded the real 278MB weekly zip, parsed the documented 534-byte fixed-width layout (also confirmed against the county's own bundled sample file), and extracted 1,410,641 delinquent (TOT_AMT_DUE > 0) records out of 5,275,610 total rows scanned. Fields decode sensibly: real dollar amounts, real due dates, real owner/address data. 249,153 records carry a pending-suit flag with real cause numbers, 7,240 carry an active bankruptcy flag with real case numbers, 1,365,479 have crossed the attorney-fee escalation threshold. Total delinquent balance across the file: $609,176,515.13.
tax_collector.portal_type: weekly bulk ASCII fixed-width Tax Roll (TRW) file download

code_enforcement.notes: Dallas County itself does not run code enforcement; it is a municipal function (e.g., City of Dallas Code Compliance / 311, City of Irving, City of Garland, each independently). Per engineering/knowledge_base guidance, county-wide code enforcement builds are out of scope unless the operator explicitly prioritizes a single municipality — Dallas County contains dozens of municipalities plus unincorporated area, so no single-portal county-level source exists.
